    name: vocabulary_id

attributes:
  vocabulary_id:
    name: vocabulary_id
    description: The ID associated with the vocabulary or ontology inside the warehouse
    title: Vocabulary ID
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/md-terminology-trove
    rank: 1000
    identifier: true
    owner: Vocabulary
    domain_of:
    - Vocabulary
    - Concept
    range: string
    required: true
  name:
    name: name
    description: Full name for the ontology
    title: Vocabulary Name
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/md-terminology-trove
    rank: 1000
    owner: Vocabulary
    domain_of:
    - Vocabulary
    range: string
    required: false
  vocabulary_uri:
    name: vocabulary_uri
    description: Official URI associated with the vocabulary
    title: Vocabulary URI
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/md-terminology-trove
    rank: 1000
    owner: Vocabulary
    domain_of:
    - Vocabulary
    range: uri
    required: true
  fhir_system:
    name: fhir_system
    description: System used within FHIR valuesets and codings
    title: FHIR System
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/md-terminology-trove
    rank: 1000
    owner: Vocabulary
    domain_of:
    - Vocabulary
    range: uri
    required: true
  prefix:
    name: prefix
    description: The authoritative namespace prefix allocated to the vocabulary. Used
      to resolve compact identifiers (CURIEs) to their full semantic URIs or FHIR
      system URLs.
    title: Canonical Curie Prefix
    todos:
    - Ensure that MapDragon and TermWeaver both rely on the same rules for prefixes
    comments:
    - Must start with a letter; thereafter allows letters, digits, underscores, hyphens,
      and dots to accommodate OLS/UMLS source variability.
    - 'RISK: In order for all of our data to correctly join, the format of the prefix
      must always align with the prefix used in this table.'
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/md-terminology-trove
    rank: 1000
    owner: Vocabulary
    domain_of:
    - Vocabulary
    range: string
    pattern: ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_\-\.]*$
  description:
    name: description
    description: Ontology description
    title: Ontology description
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/md-terminology-trove
    rank: 1000
    owner: Vocabulary
    domain_of:
    - Vocabulary
    range: string
    multivalued: false
  version:
    name: version
    description: Version associated with the current vocabulary content
    title: Version
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/md-terminology-trove
    rank: 1000
    owner: Vocabulary
    domain_of:
    - Vocabulary
    range: string
    multivalued: false
  source:
    name: source
    description: Source used for populating the terminologies members
    title: Data source
    comments:
    - This is currently poorly defined because we haven't fully defined the nature
      of the data pulls. Most likely it will end up as a filename (.owl, .obo, etc)
      or another tool, etc
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/md-terminology-trove
    rank: 1000
    owner: Vocabulary
    domain_of:
    - Vocabulary
    range: string
    multivalued: false
